title: Treesitter won't attach on first line of a file

labels.name: bug-regression
labels.description: wrong behavior that was introduced in a previous commit (please bisect)

labels.name: has:bisected
labels.description: issue has been tracked to a specific commit

body:
### Problem

Upon creating a new file, or opening an old file and inserting text to the first line of the buffer, treesitter won't attach to the new area and only starts from the old region downwards.
The last working version I tested was 469e6bfc56aa18350bfab13bef8a51b02a5b3c65

Example video:
[Screencast from 2023-04-06 19-10-09.webm](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/29790821/230346906-c0d46cec-173d-44d7-a91e-702eba52c38b.webm)

Bisect Log:
```
git bisect start
# status: waiting for both good and bad commits
# bad: [fd32a987520cb132455d61301467182cb58cddf2] test(vim.fs.normalize): enable test on Windows
git bisect bad fd32a987520cb132455d61301467182cb58cddf2
# status: waiting for good commit(s), bad commit known
# good: [10baf89712724b4b95f7c641f2012f051737003c] vim-patch:9.0.1439: start Insert mode when accessing a hidden prompt buffer (#22867)
git bisect good 10baf89712724b4b95f7c641f2012f051737003c
# bad: [81f2bce775bc7e7392b51538b94a0d62d6ab15b4] build: cmake cleanup
git bisect bad 81f2bce775bc7e7392b51538b94a0d62d6ab15b4
# good: [e30cc8be1950a6d1dec7395807966e1b5d0d9194] vim-patch:9.0.1438: .fs files are falsely recognized as forth files (#22871)
git bisect good e30cc8be1950a6d1dec7395807966e1b5d0d9194
# good: [469e6bfc56aa18350bfab13bef8a51b02a5b3c65] fix(treesitter): use capture metadata range if exists
git bisect good 469e6bfc56aa18350bfab13bef8a51b02a5b3c65
# bad: [b75acd2f94feac5b55eaa219e7beb2af93f15cf0] fix(treesitter): disable folding in inspect_tree() (#22885)
git bisect bad b75acd2f94feac5b55eaa219e7beb2af93f15cf0
# bad: [090ade4af6344a7bc4ee56a8052c0739c0428c04] refactor(treesitter): delegate region calculation to treesitter (#22576)
git bisect bad 090ade4af6344a7bc4ee56a8052c0739c0428c04
# first bad commit: [090ade4af6344a7bc4ee56a8052c0739c0428c04] refactor(treesitter): delegate region calculation to treesitter (#22576)
```

### Steps to reproduce

Have a test.c with the content of
```c
int main(){
}
```
Repro steps:
```
nvim --clean test.c
:lua vim.treesitter.start()<CR>
ggO int a;<Esc>
:InspectTree
```

### Expected behavior

Expect the tree to start at line 1, and not line 2 like the video above

### Neovim version (nvim -v)

NVIM v0.9.0-dev-1347+gfd32a9875

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

vim doesn't have treesitter

### Operating system/version

Linux 6.2.9-zen1-1-zen

### Terminal name/version

kitty 0.27.1

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-kitty

### Installation

Build from repo
